title: Ordered Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.08936v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) stabilizes policy updates by clipping the importance ratio between the new policy and the data-collecting policy. The standard rule uses one fixed clipping range for all samples. While this choice offers simplicity and effectiveness, it fails to distinguish statistically harmful extreme ratio values from large, yet tolerable changes. We study how to adapt the clipping radius to the reliability of the induced importance ratio distribution. Our case study demonstrates that reliable updates require controlling these extreme ratios, rather than merely verifying that individual ratios fall within a fixed interval. Motivated by this observation, we propose Ordered Policy Optimization (\textsc{OPO}). translated_abstract: 近端策略优化（PPO）通过裁剪新策略与数据采集策略之间的重要性比率来稳定策略更新。标准规则对所有样本使用一个固定的裁剪范围。虽然这种选择简单且有效，但它无法区分统计上有害的极端比率值与较大但可容忍的变化。我们研究了如何使裁剪半径适应所诱导的重要性比率分布的可靠性。我们的案例研究表明，可靠的更新需要控制这些极端比率，而不仅仅是验证单个比率是否落在固定区间内。基于这一观察，我们提出了有序策略优化（OPO）。在每个小批量（minibatch）中，OPO对重要性比率进行排序，选出可能对更新产生最大影响的极端比率，并为它们分配自适应的逐样本半径，而不是使用固定范围……
tldr: 提出有序策略优化（OPO），通过在每个小批量中对重要性比率排序、识别影响最大的极端比率并为其分配自适应的逐样本裁剪半径，取代PPO的固定裁剪范围，从而更可靠地控制策略更新。
en_tdlr: Ordered Policy Optimization (OPO) improves upon PPO's fixed clipping rule by sorting importance ratios within each minibatch, identifying the most influential extreme ratios, and assigning them adaptive sample-wise clipping radii for more reliable policy updates.
